x: Tolson had pulled a muscle, Norman Caves had contracted tonsilitis, Andorka was sitting very important exams and Mal Ash threatened to retire; I was unable to change his mind.

McCorquindale were competing elsewhere, and with Stan Vickers Eric Hall, Norman Caves, Mal Ash and Andorka also unavailable our team could not be said to be truly representative of the name of Belgrave.

The ever present Jim McGrath was second to Norman in the high-jump, and also the shot, and it was most pleaseing to see Andorka competing once more after examinations, to win the shot with a putt of 43'1½".
